snippet.title: LIVE: Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Punjab FC | MG ISL 2026-27 | Vertical
snippet.description:
#MGISLonYT || Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Punjab FC || LIVE || Match 21 || 31-Oct-2026 || English || #YTIndia

Mohun Bagan Super Giant welcome Punjab FC to the VYBK on Saturday night for Gameweek 4 of the MG ISL 2026-27. If recent history is anything to go by, nobody should switch off before the final whistle.

Last season's meeting in Kolkata was a five-goal thriller in which Punjab led twice before Jason Cummings curled in a stoppage-time free kick to win it 3-2 for the Mariners. Late goals have become Punjab's thing this season too. Raphaël Messi Bouli won it in stoppage time against Odisha FC, Gurkirat Singh equalised in the 90th minute against Mumbai City, and 19-year-old Sanathoi Singh struck at the death to beat Churchill Brothers SC 3-2 last weekend, leaving the Shers unbeaten with seven points. Mohun Bagan lost their opener in Guwahati but have won both games since, beating Sporting Club Delhi 2-1 with second-half goals from Lee Erwin and Miguel Figueira and then edging Chennaiyin FC 1-0 on Monday through Manvir Singh's 85th-minute goal. That leaves the Mariners one point behind Punjab, and a win here would take them past their visitors.

The southern derby comes to the Marina Arena on Saturday evening, as Chennaiyin FC host Kerala Blasters FC in Gameweek 4 of the MG ISL 2026-27.

Chennaiyin won the last meeting between these rivals in Kochi, where Imran Khan's curling shot three minutes before half-time gave the Marina Machans a 1-0 win, their first of last season and their first in Kochi in six years. This season they opened with a 1-1 draw at FC Goa, where Irfan Yadwad scored first, before losing 2-0 in Bengaluru. On Monday in Kolkata they created plenty of chances but were punished by Manvir Singh's 85th-minute goal in a 1-0 defeat to Mohun Bagan, so they are still waiting for their first win. The Blasters have had a mixed start, with a 2-0 win over Inter Kashi followed by a 4-1 defeat in Guwahati. Last weekend they were held 0-0 by Mumbai City in Kochi, where Amrinder Singh made the key saves and Mohammed Sanan was a constant threat down the flank. Both sides will see this derby as the chance to get their season going properly.

snippet.title: LIVE: Inter Kashi FC vs FC Goa | MG ISL 2026-27
snippet.description:
#MGISLonYT || Inter Kashi FC vs FC Goa || LIVE || Match 23 || 01-Nov-2026 || English || #YTIndia

Inter Kashi FC take on FC Goa on Sunday night to close out Gameweek 4 of the MG ISL 2026-27. This is a fixture with real meaning for the hosts, because it is where their top-flight story began.

The two sides met in Inter Kashi's very first ISL match last season at Fatorda, where Prasanth Karuthadathkuni scored in first-half stoppage time. Even after goalkeeper Lluís Tarrés was sent off, they held on until Dejan Dražić's late penalty to take a 1-1 draw, the club's first ever ISL point. This season has been tougher so far. Inter Kashi lost 2-0 to Kerala Blasters and drew with Odisha FC through Huidrom Thoi Singh's 89th-minute equaliser, before champions East Bengal beat them 5-1 last week. FC Goa opened with a 1-1 draw against Chennaiyin FC, rescued by a 75th-minute Chiki header. Kashi will be desperate to respond after last week, and the Gaurs will want to show they are back in the title conversation.
